theses.thesis: HK Banks are the confirmed leader (rank 1, score 1.337) with eligibility intact (trend-gate pass) and breadth of 0.615 — the most cohesive of the eligible themes. This is a stay-with-the-leader lean, not a return forecast.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: The only remaining eligible theme with a genuine trend structure: durability 0.65, hurst 'trend', breadth 0.75, crowding essentially neutral (z 0.05).
